The structure of composition Ag6Sn2 (reduced formula Ag3Sn) crystallizes in the tetragonal space group P4₂/nmc (No. 119), with a unit cell containing 16 atoms (Ag12Sn4) distributed over three independent Wyckoff orbits. Geometry-only CrystalNN analysis identifies a close-packed-like local arrangement for all three orbits: Ag centers have 12 geometric neighbors (8 Ag, 4 Sn) with distances of 2.855–3.195 Å, while Sn centers also have 12 neighbors (8 Ag, 4 Sn) at 3.085–3.195 Å. Validated polyhedron contacts show Ag–Ag, Ag–Sn, and Sn–Sn 12-vertex coordination polyhedra sharing corners, edges, and faces, and the periodic neighbor graph is three-dimensional and fully connected across all 16 sites.
